lesson.summary: Name a mutation after what it DOES, and verify it performs the regression it is named for
lesson.synthesized_rule: A mutation test named for a regression but implemented as claim-deletion validates nothing about the regression. Measured: a mutation called message-set-opened rewrote the sentence 'exactly four, closed, never a fifth' instead of actually adding a fifth value -- so five prose conjuncts were 'validated' while the real regression passed 124/124 green, twice over, in two directions the rule explicitly forbade. Two checks before trusting a mutation suite: (1) does each mutation PERFORM the forbidden change rather than delete the sentence forbidding it; (2) is the forbidden change expressible as a RELATION over parsed values rather than as the presence of prose. If a rule can be stated as a set relation, pin the relation -- prose pins price clarity and miss reclassification entirely.
